purpose: Describe doing a helpful action for someone else.
keywords: I read a book to my younger sister.
I carried my friend’s bags for them.
I taught my younger brother some kanji.
restrictions: Explicitly presenting your action as a favor can sound patronizing in some relationships.
mistake: The giver of the action is the subject, not the recipient.

segments.role: Describe doing a helpful action for someone else. て-form + あげる.
